newsitem.title: UK: GUS, British Land in property JV.
newsitem.headline: GUS, British Land in property JV.

text.p: British retail and investment group Great Universal Stores Plc said on Thursday it was forming a property joint venture with British Land Company Plc.
Under the terms of the deal, each company will own half of the joint venture which will own the investment property portfolio of GUS with a net asset value of around 868 million stg, GUS said.

GUS will receive 200 million stg cash for British Land's investment in the venture. The joint venture will also issue 500 million stg of senior debt to GUS and GUS will invest 200 million in the venture.
GUS said the joint venture would own 982 properties in the UK, valued at 900 million stg in January 1997. It would also have 62 million stg of cash resources.
GUS said the joint venture planned to obtain replacement external finance to ensure that the 500 million stg of senior debt is repaid to GUS in February 1998.
British Land will manage the properties and both companies will each appoint three board members to the joint venture.
